name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan O'Malley's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines and mechanics, fueled by his father's garage in rural County Cork. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from University College Dublin, specializing in aerodynamics. His early career saw him work with several Formula 3 teams before making the leap to Formula 1 as a junior engineer with Jordan Grand Prix. He honed his skills over the years, steadily climbing the ranks at various teams, always demonstrating a knack for identifying and resolving complex technical issues. 

As a technical director, Declan prioritizes a data-driven approach combined with fostering open communication within his team. He believes in empowering engineers to take ownership of their projects, creating a collaborative environment where innovative solutions can flourish. His dedication to precision and adaptability has earned him a reputation as a reliable and effective leader, qualities that are crucial in the fast-paced world of Formula 1.

physical.description: A man of medium build, Declan has a kind face etched with the experience of years in the motorsport industry.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Irish tea precisely at 3 PM every day.
